datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (monthly) field assessments and compiled IPC classification data into geographic datasets for Guatemala in 2022. The IPC classifications represent integrated analysis of food security conditions driven by multiple hazards including drought, conflict, and economic shocks, with results spatially mapped at administrative and sub-administrative levels.
